info.name: Select Star Metadata bi joins API

params.name: columns
params.description: A comma separated list of column guids to filter for joins that this table was a source or target column of the join.

params.name: datasources
params.description: A comma separated list of data source guids to filter for items within those data sources.

params.name: order
params.description:
Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: popularity
params.description: A comma separated list of popularity ranges (inclusive) can include integers from 1-100 ex) 1-10,90-100 would be the bottom 10 percent and the top 10 percent, respectively. Ranges can overlap.

params.name: source_tables
params.description: A comma separated list of table guids to filter for joins that this table was a source table of the join.

params.name: tables
params.description: A comma separated list of table guids to filter for joins that this table was a source or target table of the join.

items.docs:
List of the joins available in authenticated user's organization

**Required Role:** Authenticated User with Active Organization
